clips.title: The story
paras: Robo-Mechanical Guts are salvagable gearworks, conduits, and machine innards harvested from the malfunctioning constructs roaming the ruins of Gnomeregan. Gnomish engineers in Stormwind require these specific components to repair heavy tunneling vehicles meant to aid in the reclamation of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.

When High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the surviving gnomes evacuated Gnomeregan, thousands of automated mechanisms, clockwork sentries, and industrial robots were abandoned inside. In the city's radioactive aftermath, these machines continue to roam the corridors autonomously. In Stormwind City, the tinker Shoni seeks to assemble a fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to pierce the defenses of Gnomeregan and reclaim the lost city. Lacking fresh raw materials, she tasks bold adventurers with braving the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan to carve out functional robot viscera—springs, wires, and gyro-components—to refit the excavation machinery.
